description: This file defines the QuickKeyHistoryRecords class, which manages the storage, retrieval, and manipulation of quick text key history, including encoding/decoding history data, handling incognito mode, and maintaining a list of history keys.

classes.name: QuickKeyHistoryRecords
classes.description: Manages quick text key history, including loading, saving, encoding, decoding, and clearing history, with support for incognito mode.

classes.name: QuickKeyHistoryRecords.HistoryKey
classes.description: Represents a key in the history with a name and value, with custom equality and hash code implementations.

methods.name: QuickKeyHistoryRecords
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the history from preferences, decoding old device formats if necessary, and ensuring at least one history key exists.

methods.name: decodeForOldDevices
methods.description: Decodes a string-encoded history into a list of HistoryKey objects, used for backward compatibility.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a new history key, updating the list and encoding it for storage, unless in incognito mode.

methods.name: encodeForOldDevices
methods.description: Encodes a list of HistoryKey objects into a string for storage, suitable for older device formats.

methods.name: clearHistory
methods.description: Clears the current history and resets it with a default emoji key.

methods.name: getCurrentHistory
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of the current history keys, ensuring at least one exists.

methods.name: isIncognitoMode
methods.description: Returns whether the incognito mode is active.
